settings.title: How To Use
settings.content:
1. Lie down in a comfortable position
  2. Plug in the cable and ear clips.
  3. Add conductive gel and pinch it in between the ear clip. Wear the ear clips on your ear lobes. (make sure you don't have any ear jewellery on). 
  4. Turn on the device by pressing the middle button once. A long beep will indicate that it's turned on and deliver the current at Level 1. You may increase the level by tapping the middle button again. At level 2 you might feel like you are rocking on a boat. This is a normal sensation and will go away in 5 mins.
  5. Wear the Myocalme device until it turns OFF for 30 mins.
  6. Recharge until the next day.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Is MyoCalme Pro safe to use?
settings.text1: Absolutely. MyoCalme Pro is designed with safety in mind, making it suitable for regular use by both professionals and individuals.
settings.title2: How long does each session take?
settings.text2: Sessions typically last 15-30 minutes, depending on the selected program.
settings.title3: Can I use this device daily?
settings.text3: Yes, MyoCalme Pro is safe for daily use as part of your wellness routine.

settings.text:
The Myocalme Pro is a microcurrent technology that has a frequency specific waveform delivered on the ear lobes to impact the deep neurological pathways to balance out the brain activities and induce alpha signals in the brain. The alpha state is typically referred to a very calm and relaxed state of the brain activity. 

The Myocalme Pro creates an ideal homeostasis balance in the neurological pathway placing it in the parasympathetic restoration zone. In other words, Myocalme Pro helps stimulate a deep relaxation that can reduce chronic stress and nurture sleep.
